::: {#exm-prefix-form}
#### A prefix form

The prefix form (@def-prefix-form) of $(7 - 2) \times (3 + 4 \times 2)$,
the preorder of the tree of @fig-expression, is

$$
\times \; - \; 7 \; 2 \; + \; 3 \; \times \; 4 \; 2.
$$

The first $\times$ applies to the two operands that follow it, $- \; 7 \; 2$ and $+ \; 3 \; \times \; 4 \; 2$,
and the $+$ applies to $3$ and $\times \; 4 \; 2$.

:::
